newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan says hopes for fairness in US computer issue.
newsitem.headline: Japan says hopes for fairness in US computer issue.

text.p: Japan's top government spokesman said on Thursday that he hopes the United States will be fair in handling its investigation of allegations that NEC Corp was dumping supercomputers on the U.S. market.
"We strongly hope the United States will deal with the issue with fairness and transparency," Chief Cabinet Secretary Seiroku Kajiyama told a regular news conference.

The U.S. International Trade Commission voted on Wednesday to continue an investigation into a July 29 complaint by Cray Research Inc that the Japanese computer giant was dumping supercomputers in the United States.
Kajiyama said Japan and the United States should not overreact to the ITC ruling.
"With regard to this issue of supercomputers, this is a symbol of economic competition between Japan and the United States," he added.
